title: Carry the related agent body into every non-Agent dispatch payload
action: In packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/verbs/drivers/prepare.rs, three arms build a Bash payload whose prompt travels on stdin: the native-fallback cli arm (prepare.rs:1750), the Resolved::Cli arm (prepare.rs:1776) and the Resolved::Herding arm (prepare.rs:1817). Each inserts `prompt_body.clone()`. On the Agent path Claude loads the agent file itself; on these three paths nobody does, so the pane worker gets only the thin kind brief. STEP 1 — compute ONCE, next to `prompt_body`, a `pane_prompt`: when `embedded_agent_body(pinned_type)` (added by hab-1) returns Some(body), it is format!("{body}\n\n{prompt_body}"); otherwise it is `prompt_body` unchanged. Use `pane_prompt` in all three stdin inserts. `pinned_type` is already in scope at prepare.rs:1631. Do NOT touch the Agent arms (prepare.rs:1707, :1908) or the codex spawn_agent arm — their bytes are pinned at tests.rs:6524-6526 and must stay green. STEP 2 — existing byte-identity tests WILL go red, correctly, and must be repaired, not deleted. DISPATCH_RUNTIMES (prepare.rs:40) is [codex, claude, pi] and the BRIEF_HOST fixture (tests.rs:6893) gives `pi` herding slots, so every walk over runtime x kind now sees the agent body on pi/gather (bee-gather) and pi/reviewer (bee-review); pi/advisor is unchanged because its pinned_type is general-purpose. The helper `dispatched_body` (tests.rs:6911) reads `stdin` as well as `prompt`, which is why these tests see it. Repair each of these by expecting the agent body as a PREFIX on a herding-shaped slot while keeping exact bytes everywhere else — a shared test helper that wraps the expected body is preferred over editing each assertion by hand: no_brief_leaves_every_runtime_and_kind_pair_exactly_as_it_was (tests.rs:6949), a_whitespace_only_brief_is_no_brief_at_all (:7000), a_gather_dispatch_carrying_expertise_renders_the_reading_list (:7808), a_reviewer_dispatch_carrying_expertise_renders_the_reading_list (:7828), a_briefless_advisor_dispatch_carrying_expertise_renders_the_reading_list (:7851 — should stay byte-identical, confirm it does), no_resolvable_anchor_leaves_every_runtime_and_kind_pair_byte_identical (:8106), a_featureless_dispatch_reads_no_default_anchor_even_when_one_exists (:8166), a_whitespace_only_request_is_no_request_at_all (:8272), an_unusable_anchor_degrades_to_no_block_and_never_fails_the_dispatch (:8297). Run the full drivers test module and repair every remaining red the same way. Never delete or weaken an assertion to make it pass.

truths: a herding gather payload's stdin starts with the bee-gather body and still ends with the gather kind brief
a herding cell payload's stdin starts with the bee-build body and still carries the full worker contract below it
a role whose pinned_type is general-purpose (advisor) produces stdin byte-identical to today
the Agent-path assertions at tests.rs:6524-6526 pass unchanged - no edit to those constants
new tests cover the gather herding case, the cell herding case, and the general-purpose no-op case
every pre-existing test named in the action is green again, repaired by expecting the body, never by deleting or weakening an assertion
cargo test over the whole drivers module is green

trace.outcome: Every non-Agent dispatch payload now carries the related bee agent body above its kind brief

mistakes.wrong: the new expected_dispatched_body test helper keys off runtime == "pi" rather than off the resolved slot being herding
mistakes.better: it encodes the BRIEF_HOST fixture instead of the behavior, so a fixture change would let it pass wrongly; keying it on the resolved transport would have been better

report.outcome: pane_prompt built once at prepare.rs:1638 and used in all three Bash stdin arms (1751, 1777, 1818); 9 byte-identity tests repaired through a new expected_dispatched_body helper; 2 new tests pin the gather and cell herding shapes
